What you'll do As our Recruiter – Tech & Operations, you will take ownership of recruiting across our organization, with a strong focus on Technology roles and additional responsibility for Operations and other business functions . You will report directly to our Senior HR Manager and work closely with hiring managers across the company. We are looking for an experienced, independent recruiter who is comfortable owning the full recruitment process and proactively driving hiring needs from initial intake through to successful hire. This is a highly hands-on role. You will not just coordinate recruitment processes — you will actively source, engage, assess and build relationships with candidates, particularly across our technical talent landscape. Your tasks in a nutshell: End-to-End Recruitment: Independently manage the full recruitment process, from defining requirements with hiring managers and sourcing candidates to interviews, offer management and closing. Tech Recruiting Focus: Own and drive recruitment for technical roles across Engineering, Product, Data and other technology-related functions. You understand technical profiles and know how to identify and engage strong tech talent. Operations Recruiting: Support and independently recruit for Operations and selected business roles as required. Proactive Talent Sourcing: Build and maintain strong talent pipelines through direct sourcing, LinkedIn, referrals, networks and other relevant channels rather than relying solely on inbound applications. Stakeholder Partnership: Work closely with hiring managers and the Senior HR Manager to understand hiring needs, challenge requirements where appropriate and ensure an efficient, high-quality recruitment process. Candidate Experience: Own the candidate journey and represent Smart Host professionally throughout the process. Recruitment Ownership: Take responsibility for your roles and actively drive processes forward. You are comfortable working independently, prioritizing competing hiring needs and keeping stakeholders informed. Hands-on HR Support: We are a growing team, so you are happy to roll up your sleeves and support other HR activities when recruitment capacity allows. You see yourself as part of the broader HR team, not just as a recruiter. Continuous Improvement: Help us improve our recruiting processes, tools, employer branding and overall talent acquisition strategy as we grow. What you bring Recruiting Experience: You have several years of professional recruiting experience, ideally with a strong track record in technical recruiting . Tech Recruiting Expertise: You have successfully recruited software engineers and other technical profiles and are comfortable understanding technical requirements and translating them into effective sourcing strategies. End-to-End Ownership: You are used to managing recruitment processes independently and taking full ownership of your roles. Self-Starter Mentality: You don't wait to be told what to do. You proactively identify what needs to happen, take action and keep processes moving. Strong Sourcing Skills: You know how to find and engage passive candidates and are comfortable building talent pipelines from scratch. Business & Operations Recruiting: Experience recruiting Operations or other non-technical business roles is a strong advantage. Stakeholder Management: You communicate confidently with hiring managers and senior stakeholders and can advise, challenge and partner effectively throughout the hiring process. Hands-on & Pragmatic: You enjoy getting things done yourself. You are not afraid to jump into different HR topics or support the wider team when priorities shift. Ownership Mindset: You take responsibility for outcomes, pay attention to detail and care about delivering a great experience for both candidates and hiring teams. Fluency in English: You communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing. German skills are an advantage. Entitlement to work in Germany: You are legally entitled to work in Germany and do not require visa sponsorship. For legal hiring reasons, we can only consider candidates based in Germany for this role. Why Smart Host Real impact: You will have direct influence on our hiring strategy, the teams we build and the growth of Smart Host. Hybrid or remote within Germany: Work hybrid from our Berlin office or remotely from within Germany. We occasionally bring the team together in Berlin for workshops, planning, and collaboration. Experience working in automotive or similar asset-intensive industries is beneficial. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate across functional teams. Ability to work on-site in Cairo, manage multiple priorities, and deliver within agreed timelines. Fluency in English; proficiency in Arabic is an advantage.

review_candidates.title: Manager, Post Production - Indonesia
review_candidates.description: Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time. The Opportunity Netflix is revolutionizing entertainment, enabling stories from anywhere to reach audiences everywhere. As our Indonesian original slate continues to grow, world-class post-production has become central to how we bring our creators' visions to life at the technical and creative bar our members expect. We are looking for a Manager, Post Production to oversee a slate of Indonesian Netflix titles—spanning series and films—from development through final delivery. You will partner closely with creators, production partners, internal cross-functional teams, and post vendors to elevate post-production quality, operational excellence, and workflow innovation across the region, ensuring that each project delivers on schedule, within budget, and at Netflix's high technical and creative standards. This is an opportunity to help shape the future of post-production for Indonesian storytelling, at the center of one of Netflix's fastest-growing content regions. Key Responsibilities Creative & Technical Direction Set post-production strategy for Indonesian titles, from development through delivery. Provide early guidance on scripts, budgets, schedules, and creative and technical needs. Guide key decisions across editorial, sound, color, VFX, mastering, and delivery to uphold Netflix's standards. Slate & Production Oversight Oversee post-production health across multiple titles, spotting and resolving risks early. Lead cross-functional decision-making across creators, production teams, vendors, and internal partners. Balance creative ambition, quality, budget, and schedule across the slate. Innovation & Workflow Improvement Shape Indonesia's post-production innovation roadmap, informed by industry and technology trends. Drive adoption of new tools and workflows that improve quality, efficiency, and scale. Turn lessons from individual titles into scalable improvements across the slate. Strategic & Regional Impact Build the talent, vendor, and infrastructure capacity needed to support the Indonesian slate. Strengthen Indonesia's post-production ecosystem through vendor partnerships and local talent development. Represent Indonesia in regional post-production discussions, shaping shared Netflix tools and workflows. What We're Looking For Core Experience 8+ years of experience in post-production for film or television, studio or independent. Proven experience managing Indonesian-language content, with established relationships across Indonesia's post-production vendors and crews. Track record building and scaling vendor or talent networks within a regional market. Fluency in Indonesian and English. Technical & Creative Skills Strong understanding of post workflows, formats, and industry-standard editorial, color, and mastering tools, including 4K and HDR. Ability to give clear, creative feedback while safeguarding schedule and budget. Experience with VFX workflows and production is a plus. Leadership & Soft Skills Exceptional communication across creative, technical, and vendor teams. Proven ability to drive process or technology change across teams and partners. Strong problem-solving orientation, comfortable managing multiple titles concurrently in fast-moving, ambiguous environments. Cultural Values Fit Demonstrates Netflix's values: independent decision-making, clear communication, inclusivity, curiosity, courage, and high integrity. Comfortable working without a structural hierarchy and navigating global workflows and time zones. Passion for storytelling, elevating local talent, and building sustainable post-production ecosystems. Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner.
